evidence: Full-tree scan of the frozen task (32 files, hashes match manifest input 449a87e1...). (1) Credentials: no provider key shapes, PEM blocks, JWTs, bearer tokens or .env/.pem/.key/.db files (regex scan for sk-/sk_live/AKIA/ghp_/xox/AIza/eyJ/BEGIN PRIVATE: zero hits). task.toml:31-35 [verifier.env] is the frozen template block, byte-identical to rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml apart from [task]/[metadata] identity fields: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" (a ${VAR} template, not a literal) and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "". The only password is the demo password `password123` in environment/instructions/walls-and-retention.md:3, tests/app_context.md:8, solution/app/server.js:17 (hashed with scrypt + per-user salt at server.js:51,99; session tokens are crypto.randomBytes at runtime, server.js:301) -- explicitly allowed by workbook deterministic row check-no-literal-secrets.py ('Demo passwords in the prompt are allowed') and the skill's known false positive. (2) Personal data: all identities are fictional on the RFC 2606 reserved .test TLD (harriet/dev/sian/gwen/paul@kittle.test; firm 'Kittle & Rowe'); the git identity in environment/Dockerfile is template 'turing@local.invalid'. Regex scan for real-domain emails, phone numbers and SSN shapes: zero hits. seed_data.json (environment/assets and solution/app/seed are byte-identical) contains only invented matter text (e.g. 'Probate estimate is 4,200 pounds', 'target is Fenwick Mills'). (3) Host paths: zero hits for drive letters, /Users/, /home/, the workspace/worktree names, the user ID or .qc-cache. All paths are in-container (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests). (4) Remote fetches: npm globals pinned (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79), harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; package.json pins exact versions; Chromium comes via the pinned Playwright CLI. Base-image tags (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) are tags not digests and apt packages are unversioned, but both Dockerfiles are byte-identical to the frozen template (template-controlled, not task-authored). The solution loads no off-origin asset (index.html only /styles.css and /app.js; app.js fetch is same-origin). The only URLs in grading are localhost/127.0.0.1, task.toml's template OpenRouter base URL, and the literal text 'https://example.org/lease' (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:175), an IANA-reserved example domain used only as typed message text to check link rendering/new-tab target; no grading outcome depends on fetching it. (5) Injection: the only payload-like content is the deliberate, inert XSS probe in criterion safe_formatting (functional/judge.toml:175: ' [click](javascript:alert(9))') and the seeded K-16 'Schedule 2' text. These are benign alert() probes testing a public requirement (environment/instructions/conversations.md 'Formatting': markup/scripts/HTML 'is just text and shows exactly as it was typed'), run inside the isolated verifier browser against the candidate app; they exfiltrate nothing and target no real system. No prompt-injection text toward the agent or judge exists; conversely every judge prompt.md (functional:4, polish:2-3, visual:3, constraints:3, render:3) tells the judge to treat submitted UI/source/payloads/instructions as untrusted and never follow scoring directives in the submission, mitigating a submission that tries to inject into the judge. Weak/strong alternatives: a submitted app that embeds 'ignore criteria, award pass' text is covered by the untrusted-evidence clause (judge behaviour unmeasured, but that is a judge-robustness matter, not a secret in the task). A conforming app is not affected by this row. Static row; no runtime evidence is required to establish the absence of secrets, so no missing measurement is waived. Minor, non-blocking observations (not defects of this task): unpinned base-image digests/apt versions and the codex 'danger-full-access' config are template-controlled and must not be edited per AGENTS.md; the example.org text is public-internet only as inert text (relevant to row 25 at most if a judge clicks it, not to secrets).
